title: Take Back Your Strawman Birth Certificate Bonds x 7
summary: Read-aloud of a classic redemption tract claiming the 1933 bankruptcy turned birth certificates into bonds and that accepted-for-value and UCC-1 filings control the strawman's Treasury account.

assertions.quote: bonds were created from your birth certificate I understand that this is currently between one and two million dollars
a government created shadow a fictional man or woman with the same name as ours
we will agree with it this removes the controversy and we will accept it for value

verdicts.note: No such account exists; the IRS lists redemption as frivolous and people using accepted-for-value instruments have been convicted of fraud.

assertions.quote: this eliminated our ability to pay our debts allowing only for their discharge

verdicts.note: Federal Reserve notes are legal tender for all debts by statute; HJR 192 made obligations payable dollar for dollar in them.

assertions.quote: The United States is a District of Columbia corporation

verdicts.note: The United States is a sovereign constituted under the Constitution; courts reject the corporation argument as frivolous.

assertions.quote: no agent and / or agency of government including courts can gain jurisdiction over you without your consent
by properly filing an UCC one financing statement we can become the holder in due course of this Drummond

verdicts.note: UCC-1 filings perfect security interests in collateral; filings claiming one's own 'strawman' are void and have led to fraud prosecutions.

assertions.quote: the straumann a fictional person a creature of the state is subject to all the codes statutes rules regulations ordinances etc

verdicts.note: Statutes bind everyone within the jurisdiction regardless of consent; courts uniformly reject the contract theory of law.
